decision_scope: research and engineering readiness; no clinical deployment approval

objectives.basis: Every evaluated profile fails the frozen failure-inclusive normalized WER <= 5% admission gate; best expanded short-clip result is 8.70%.
No independent clinician-adjudicated acceptance set, approved critical-error and role-safety tolerances, or qualified clinical acceptance review is available.
The existing application end-to-end ASR test uses a synthetic adapter; the real local model pilot is not bound to candidate-note review and approved export in one system-level test.
No CI status checks are reported for the reviewed exact source commit; required backend, PostgreSQL, container and frontend lanes lack complete exact-HEAD evidence.

rule: Missing evidence is never PASS; this report does not authorize clinical use or model promotion.
